overview_description: Create, amend, cancel and read purchase invoices, their lines, notes, files, payments and credit note applications.
intro: A purchase invoice is a bill from a supplier. These endpoints create, amend, cancel and reactivate purchase invoices, read their lines, payments and credit note applications, and manage their notes and attached files. There are 22 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Deleting a purchase invoice or one of its notes cannot be undone.** Cancel a purchase invoice instead if you may need it again.
notes: **Every write body is wrapped in `purchase_invoice`.** The cancel and reactivate calls take an empty object.
**A new purchase invoice is `active`.** Cancelling sets it to `inactive` and reactivating sets it back to `active`.
**The lines read is not a paged list.** It returns `purchase_invoice.lines`, and one line comes back as `purchase_invoice.line`.
**A line can be addressed by its dashed `uuid` or by its listed `id`.** An unknown `uuid` returns `404`.
**The credit note application read is not scoped to the invoice.** Any application can be read through any purchase invoice that exists.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records are under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.

endpoints.title: List purchase invoices
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of purchase invoices.
endpoints.description: Lists the purchase invoices on the account, one page at a time, under `data`. Pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter the list as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Creates a purchase invoice for a supplier and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Creates a purchase invoice from a supplier's `account_id` and its lines, wrapped in `purchase_invoice`. A line takes an existing item by `item_id`, or a new one by `item_name` with a price under `item_price_snapshot`. The new invoice is `active`.

item_name.description: The name of an item that does not exist yet.

item_price_snapshot.description: The unit price for a new item, under `pricing_rule.price`.

item_id.description: The `id` of an existing item, instead of `item_name`.

endpoints.title: List notes across purchase invoices
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of notes from every purchase invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the notes of all purchase invoices together, one page at a time, under `data`. Other fields filter the list as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of purchase invoice notes.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Deletes a purchase invoice. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes the purchase invoice. The call returns `204` with no body, and reading the invoice afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Returns one purchase invoice with its lines under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase invoice with its supplier, lines, totals, payment status and KPIs under `purchase_invoice`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

404.description: No purchase invoice has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Amend a purchase invoice's lines
endpoints.summary: Adds or changes lines on a purchase invoice and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Changes the lines of the purchase invoice, wrapped in `purchase_invoice.lines`. Each entry has an `op`: `add` with an `item_id` and `item_quantity` adds a line, and `change` with the line's dashed `uuid` changes its quantity or price.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

op.description: `add` to add a line, or `change` to change one.

uuid.description: For `change`: the line's `uuid`, in dashed form.

item_id.description: For `add`: the `id` of the item to add.

endpoints.title: Cancel a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Cancels a purchase invoice and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Cancels the purchase invoice, which sets its status to `inactive`. Send an empty object as the body. Reactivate it with the reactivate call.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice's information
endpoints.summary: Returns the header information of one purchase invoice under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase invoice's header fields, such as its dates, totals, status and supplier, under `purchase_invoice`, without its lines.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

endpoints.title: Update a purchase invoice's information
endpoints.summary: Changes header fields of a purchase invoice and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Updates header fields of the purchase invoice, such as `origin`, wrapped in `purchase_invoice`. The updated invoice comes back under `purchase_invoice`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

endpoints.title: List a purchase invoice's lines
endpoints.summary: Returns the lines of a purchase invoice under `purchase_invoice.lines`.
endpoints.description: Returns the purchase invoice's lines as `purchase_invoice.lines`, not as a paged `data` list. Use a line's `uuid` or `id` to read it on its own.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: List a purchase invoice's notes
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the notes on a purchase invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the notes on the purchase invoice under `data`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of the invoice's notes.

endpoints.title: Create a purchase invoice note
endpoints.summary: Adds a note, with an optional file, to a purchase invoice and returns it under `note`.
endpoints.description: Adds a note to the purchase invoice. Send a multipart form with the text as the `note` field and, optionally, a file to attach. The new note comes back under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

note.description: The note text. HTML is accepted.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

endpoints.title: List a purchase invoice's credit note applications
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the purchase credit notes spent on a purchase invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the purchase credit note applications on the purchase invoice under `data`: each one shows the credit note spent, the payment that spent it and the amount.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of the invoice's credit note applications.

endpoints.title: List a purchase invoice's purchase payments
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the purchase payments made against a purchase invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the purchase payments applied to the purchase invoice under `data`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of the invoice's purchase payments.

endpoints.title: Reactivate a purchase invoice
endpoints.summary: Reactivates a cancelled purchase invoice and returns it under `purchase_invoice`.
endpoints.description: Reactivates a cancelled purchase invoice, which sets its status back to `active`. Send an empty object as the body.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice line
endpoints.summary: Returns one line of a purchase invoice under `purchase_invoice.line`.
endpoints.description: Returns a single line of the purchase invoice under `purchase_invoice.line`. Address the line by its `uuid` in dashed form, or by the `id` the lines list shows.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_line_uuid
parameters.description: The line's `uuid` in dashed form, or its `id` from the lines list.

404.description: The purchase invoice has no line with that `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Update a purchase invoice note
endpoints.summary: Replaces the text of a purchase invoice note and returns it under `note`.
endpoints.description: Changes the note's text. Send a multipart form with the new text as the `note` field and, optionally, a file to attach. The updated note comes back under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

note.description: The new note text. HTML is accepted.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice note
endpoints.summary: Returns one note of a purchase invoice under `note`.
endpoints.description: Returns the note with its content, attachments and watchers under `note`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

404.description: The purchase invoice has no note with that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Delete a purchase invoice note
endpoints.summary: Deletes a note from a purchase invoice. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Deletes the note. The call returns `204` with no body, and reading the note afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

endpoints.title: List a purchase invoice note's files
endpoints.summary: Returns the files attached to one purchase invoice note.
endpoints.description: Lists the files attached to the note under `data`, with each file's name, type, size and `uuid`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice note file
endpoints.summary: Returns the details of one file attached to a purchase invoice note, under `file`.
endpoints.description: Returns one attachment's name, content type, size, `uuid` and link under `file`. Address the file by its `uuid`.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, from the note create or the notes list.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The attachment's `uuid`, from the note's `attachments`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a purchase invoice's credit note application
endpoints.summary: Returns one purchase credit note application under `purchase_credit_note_application`.
endpoints.description: Returns the application with the credit note, the payment and the amount under `purchase_credit_note_application`. The application is not checked against the invoice in the path: any application can be read through any purchase invoice that exists.

parameters.name: purchase_invoice_id
parameters.description: The purchase invoice's `id`.

parameters.name: application_id
parameters.description: The purchase credit note application's `id`.

limit.description: The page size the API applied.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.

prev_cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page.
